confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the supplied comparables; no live listings or price pages were checked. Restaurant and draft beer anchors are the more reliable; hostel and hotel anchors vary with season, area and lead time and carry the most uncertainty. Cocktail and wine_glass were set from the beer anchor (about 2.2x and 1.2x) because direct price knowledge for them is weaker. The FX rate comes from search-result excerpts of the RBA page, whose date labels were inconsistent, so verify the F11.1 table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No close comparable in the supplied set, so Cape Town was placed relative to Cairo, Marrakech and Manila. Restaurant meals and dorm and private hostel rates sit above all three; hotel rates fall between the Cairo/Manila and Marrakech levels; beer sits above Cairo and Manila but well below Marrakech. July falls in Cape Town's winter, generally a lower-demand period for accommodation, and the hotel and hostel anchors assume that.
